name: Levothyroxine
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Phosphate binders (calcium carbonate, sevelamer, lanthanum) and ferrous sulfate
key_interactions.effect: Bind levothyroxine and reduce its absorption (label).
key_interactions.action: Give levothyroxine at least 4 hours apart.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Bile acid sequestrants and ion-exchange resins (cholestyramine, colestipol, colesevelam, sodium polystyrene sulfonate)
key_interactions.action: Give levothyroxine at least 4 hours before, or monitor TSH.

key_interactions.effect: Reduced absorption from lower gastric acidity (label).
Faster levothyroxine metabolism; higher dose needs (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor thyroid function when added or stopped.

key_interactions.effect: Total and free T4 may fall 20 to 40%, usually with normal TSH (label).
